extends.description: An schematic override. It can be a local schematic or from another collection (in the format 'collection:schematic')

factory.description: A folder or file path to the schematic factory

hidden.description: Whether or not this schematic should be listed by the tooling. This does not prevent the tooling to run this schematic, just removes its name from listSchematicNames().

private.description: Whether or not this schematic can be called from an external schematic, or a tool. This implies hidden: true.

schema.description: Location of the schema.json file of the schematic

schematics.description: A map of schematic names to schematic details

build.description: Compiles the project and bundles assets.

description:
Our collection builds on the shared “common-collection” and is currently at version 1.2.0. It provides three primary schematics—**build**, **test**, and **publish**—each tailored for a specific stage of the development workflow.

The **build** schematic compiles the project and bundles assets. Its factory lives at `./src/build/index`, and it can be invoked via the aliases `b` or `compile`. This schematic is publicly listed (`hidden: false`) and callable by external tools (`private: false`), with its validation schema located at `./src/build/schema.json`. The **test** schematic runs both unit and integration tests; its factory is `./src/test/index` and it is reachable with the alias `t`. Because it is meant for internal use, it is hidden from standard listings (`hidden: true`) and marked as private (`private: true`), with its schema at `./src/test/schema.json`. Finally, the **publish** schematic publishes the package to the registry. Its factory path is `./src/publish`, it overrides the implementation from `npm-collection:publish`, and it remains visible (`hidden: false`).
